purpose: The list of past conversations with an assistant, in a side panel or drawer: titles grouped by when they were last active (Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 days, Previous 30 days, Older), the open one marked current, and an optional Delete per row. Choosing a row sets `v-model` to its id; the owner loads that conversation into `Conversation`.
useWhen: An assistant keeps past conversations and the person returns to one.
The left rail or a drawer of a chat page.
related: conversation` — shows the conversation the history selects.
drawer` — holds the history on narrow screens.
bestPractices: Title each conversation from its first prompt, short; the full title shows on hover through `title`.
Pass `now` from the server render (or a fixed reference) so the groups match on the server and the client.
Confirm deletes of anything older than today with a `ConfirmDialog` in the `remove` handler.
